---
title: Installation
description: Install DASCore with uv or mamba, add optional extras, try a pre-release, or set up a development copy.
---

## With uv

[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) installs into a uv project, or into any virtual environment:

```bash
uv add "dascore[extras]"         # in a uv project
uv pip install "dascore[extras]" # in a virtual environment
```

## With mamba

[mamba](https://mamba.readthedocs.io/) installs the conda-forge package:

```bash
mamba install -c conda-forge dascore
```

`pip install "dascore[extras]"` and `conda install -c conda-forge dascore` also work.

These install the latest stable release. To try a newer pre-release, see [Pre-releases](#pre-releases).

## Optional extras

`[extras]` adds SEG-Y, miniSEED, Zarr, and NetCDF support, plus xarray and dask (for [xarray support](tutorial/xarray.qmd)), Parquet (for saving annotations), ObsPy, and faster numerical backends. Without it, `dascore` alone is a lighter install that reads the HDF5-based formats most DAS instruments write.

## Pre-releases

Allow pre-releases, and upgrade DASCore if it is already installed (this lets dependencies resolve to pre-releases too):

```bash
uv pip install --prerelease=allow --upgrade-package dascore "dascore[extras]"
```

Pre-releases are published to PyPI only, not conda-forge.

## Other ways to install

- [Docker](recipes/docker_basic.qmd): build an image of the stable release.
- [Development installation](contributing/dev_install.qmd): an editable copy of the repository, for work on DASCore itself.
